title: Cab noise with the design speed not stated
why: 79 dB meets the 80 dB row and fails the 78 dB row; the speed picks the row.

spec.name: Cab noise with the design speed not stated

noise.cab_max_speed_db.rationale: Noise TSI 4.2.4 Table 5 (cab, for units fitted with a cab: standstill with horns 95 dB; at vmax 78 dB if vmax < 250 km/h, 80 dB if 250 ≤ vmax < 350 km/h): the row depends on vmax, which is not supplied; 79 passes one row and fails the other.
